required_columns.description: Globally unique raw trajectory-point identifier.
Study-scoped primary-human-hepatocyte donor identifier.
Calibration, internal validation, or independent held-out assignment.
Stable primary-study identifier such as DOI, PMID, or repository accession.
Exact movie, frame range, repository file, and row locator.
Must be Homo sapiens for this intake.
Exact primary-human-hepatocyte preparation and donor context.
Exact 2D, sandwich, spheroid, organoid, precision-cut, or in-situ context.
Identifier joining all points of one tracked physical cargo.
Biological replicate identifier; it must not be treated as a new donor.
Directly labeled vesicle, organelle, protein complex, or other tracked cargo.
Exact label, construct, probe, and imaging compatibility statement.
Measured or directly annotated starting compartment.
Measured or directly annotated destination compartment.
Microtubule, actin, or explicitly unresolved/mixed track system.
Directly established motor identity or the explicit token not_resolved.
Non-negative integer frame index within the raw trajectory.
Non-negative elapsed seconds from the first tracked frame.
Raw x coordinate in micrometres in the declared reference frame.
Raw y coordinate in micrometres in the declared reference frame.
Raw z coordinate in micrometres; use null only through a separate 2D contract, not this 3D intake.
Cell-fixed, microscope-stage, organelle-fixed, or other exact coordinate frame.
Finite non-negative localization uncertainty in micrometres.
Finite positive acquisition interval in seconds.
Observed trajectory event at this frame.
Exact microscopy modality and trajectory-extraction pipeline.
Viability or health context reported for the imaged cell.

conditional_columns.description: Numeric ATP readout measured in the same cell and time context.
Original ATP unit; required whenever atp_value is present.
ATP assay; required whenever atp_value is present.
Numeric motor occupancy measured on this cargo when available.
Original occupancy unit; required whenever motor_occupancy_value is present.
Exact motor, track, ATP, or trafficking perturbation.
Original perturbation unit; required whenever perturbation_value is present.
Tracked partner identifier for fusion or fission events.
Original lost-track, field-of-view, occlusion, or detection-limit status.
